context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 296 Journey Rules Execution Engine tests completed. All 22 backend API tests passed. Tested features: (1) Background loop: journey_engine_loop starts at app startup - verified via logs showing '🎯 Journey Engine loop started'. (2) POST /api/pms-pro/journey-engine/run-once - admin/manager only, returns {ok, rules_processed, fires}. Receptionist gets 403. (3) GET /api/pms-pro/journey-fires - paginated list of fires with rule_name, trigger, action, guest_name, ok, fired_at. Supports property_id and limit params. (4) POST /api/pms-pro/journey-rules/{rule_id}/test-fire - manual fire against a booking, bypasses idempotency (manual=True flag), inserts side-effect into correct collection. (5) Action execution verified: notify_manager→team_chat, create_task→staff_tasks, trigger_housekeeping→housekeeping_tasks with priority=high. (6) Idempotency: Running engine twice does not double-fire same (rule, booking) pair. Manual test-fire can fire same pair multiple times. (7) RBAC: receptionist gets 403 on /journey-engine/run-once and /journey-rules/{id}/test-fire. (8) Regression: All Iter 295 PMS Pro endpoints (smart-assign, ai-concierge, journey-rules CRUD, anomalies) still pass. Frontend: Journey Rules tab shows 'Şimdi çalıştır' button (data-testid='journey-run-now-btn') that triggers engine and shows toast 'Engine çalıştı: N aksiyon · M kural'. 'Geçmiş' toggle (data-testid='journey-history-toggle') shows fires history table with columns: ZAMAN, KURAL, TRIGGER, ACTION, MİSAFİR, DURUM. Rules table has 'Tetiklenme' column showing fires_count. last_fired_at displayed below rule name when set.
